bio.text:
ningbojian，软件开发学习者，主攻 Python 桌面与工具应用，也涉足 Web 与机器人方向。MultiFuncCalculator 集成科学计算、进制转换与 2048、数独等小游戏；RoboArmDev-Showcase 打通机械臂绘画写字的图像处理与轨迹生成；另有 Django 姓氏文化可视化站点。

亮点：
- 公开仓库 12 个，关注者 2 人
- MultiFuncCalculator：计算器与益智游戏合集
- RoboArmDev-Showcase：机械臂绘画写字链路
bio.text_en:
I'm a software development learner focused on Python desktop and utility apps, with some exposure to web and robotics. MultiFuncCalculator bundles scientific calculation, base conversion and puzzle games like 2048 and Sudoku; RoboArmDev-Showcase covers the image processing and trajectory pipeline behind a robotic arm drawing and writing; I also built a Django-based surname culture visualization site.

Highlights:
- 12 public repos, 2 followers
- MultiFuncCalculator: calculator and puzzle game collection
- RoboArmDev-Showcase: robotic arm drawing/writing pipeline
